author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage visits the puppets department of @LAIKAStudios to meet the characters of their new film Wildwood. Oliver Jones, Head of Character and Practical Effects, introduces Adam to the range of stop-motion puppets created for the film to give us a close look at the intricate design, fabrication, and engineering that goes into each of these incredible puppets. 

Wildwood is in theaters October 23rd and tickets are available at: https://wildwoodmovie.com/

Shot by Joey Fameli and Josh Self
Edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
